text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
No way in hell... Her aim's crazy good...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What the hell is with
this "Wagahai-chan" crap!?
Screw this, I'm outta here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why...
There's no way this score is real...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just how many combos did it take to reach this point...?
'Wagahai-chan'... is insane.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... "Wagahai-chan"...
I feel like I've seen that somewhere before...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey...
Did you just say "Wagahai-chan"?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? It doesn't concern you, does it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I DO, okay... Wait, is that player
"Wagahai-chan" actually you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: !? You know about it too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...You're not just insane at FPS games,
but puzzle games too? ...You're a genius."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I just remembered, but
I think I might've seen the name 'Wagahai-chan'
in real life before...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Seriously!? Where?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure I saw them playing a dance game
at the arcade in the shopping mall...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So if I go there, I might find out who "Wagahai-chan" really is, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
We made it, but...
Isn't it kinda bad if they figure out where we are?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's a problem I can actually solve. No reason not to crack it, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I guess that might be true, but...
Huh, there's a crowd gathering...

And just as the two looked over from a distance,
an Umamusume parted the crowd
and made her appearance—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ That was so much fun!
Active games where you move your body are definitely the best♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Wagahai-chan"... beat the high score again!
Guess true geniuses really do exist, huh...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"It stings, but...
After seeing a score like that, nobody's gonna feel like challenging it..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently. So what're you gonna do?
Are you gonna challenge the "genius"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. If they ain't cheatin', that means there's a chance to win.
What about you, what're you gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not really... Same as always.
I'm just aiming for a high score.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah. Well then, let's both do our best.
